title: Word Ladder: A Locksmith Recutting One Notch at a Time
summary: Words one letter apart form a graph; breadth-first search finds the fewest keys from cold to warm.

analogy.scenario: A locksmith turns a key cut COLD into one cut WARM by recutting one notch at a time. Every key along the way must open some door in the building, listed on the building's key register.

mapping.real: Number of keys in the chain

takeaway.pattern: Breadth-first search on an implicit graph
takeaway.summary: Treat each word as a node and connect words one letter apart. BFS from the start word, level by level; the first time the goal comes off the queue, its level is the shortest ladder.
takeaway.timeComplexity: O(n × L × 26) for n words of length L
whenToUse: Fewest single changes between two states
Graphs you build on the fly from a rule

scenes.narration: A locksmith must turn a key cut cold into one cut warm, recutting one notch at a time. Every key along the way must open a door on the building's register.
scenes.caption: Recut a COLD key into a WARM key, one notch at a time

scenes.narration: Trying every possible chain would recut the same keys over and over. Instead, link keys that differ by one notch and search outward.
scenes.caption: Trying every chain of keys repeats work

scenes.narration: Start with cold in the queue: a chain of one key.
scenes.caption: Start with COLD: a chain of 1 key

scenes.narration: One notch away from cold, only cord is on the register. It joins the queue as a chain of two keys.
scenes.caption: One notch from COLD: CORD

scenes.narration: From cord, word and card are one notch away. Both join the back of the queue, after a divider: chains of three keys.
scenes.caption: From CORD: WORD and CARD, chains of 3

scenes.narration: Word added ward and worm. Card is one notch from ward too, but ward is already in line with a chain just as short, so card adds nothing.
scenes.caption: WARD was already reached from WORD: skip it

scenes.narration: From ward, one notch reaches warm, the goal, as a chain of five keys.
scenes.caption: From WARD: WARM, a chain of 5

scenes.narration: When warm comes off the queue, every shorter chain has been tried, so five keys is the fewest: cold, cord, card, ward, warm.
scenes.caption: WARM comes off the queue: 5 keys

scenes.narration: Keys are words, a recut notch is a one-letter change, and the register is the word list. BFS level by level finds the shortest ladder.
scenes.caption: Keys are words; one notch is one letter
